name: Dokodemo Sukishite Itsudemo Sukishite
original_name: どこでもすきしていつでもすきして
source:
Kou Amano was an ordinary high school student. However, worried about ending his school life without anything fun, he begins approaching the 5 girls he liked. He succeeds as a result and develops a overly romantic relationship doing this and that, here and there!!

[From [url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=528]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
translation:
天野耕是一名普通高中生。担心自己的校园生活会在毫无乐趣的情况下结束，他开始主动接近自己喜欢的五名少女，结果竟然成功了，并与她们发展出过分甜蜜、无论何时何地都亲密无间的关系！

[摘自[url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=528]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
